_rule: Two tiers, because brand-voice.md §8 distinguishes them: 'Name the competitor category (GA4, Clarity, agencies) and draw the line. Don't attack a named competitor's brand directly.'

approved_contrast_targets._note: Naming these is on-brand and load-bearing in Helium's best-performing post titles. Allowed anywhere, including titles. Restricted to the diagnostics-analytics cluster by clusters.json.

hedges._source: brand-voice.md §6 — hedges are banned outright. Gate 5 fails the draft on any match.

hard_superlatives._note: Claims about the world rather than framing. Banned regardless of how boastful the brief is.

enterprise_jargon._source: customer-language.md §7 — none of this appears in how Helium's customers speak

required_title_qualifiers._source: entity-record.md §1 — 'Helium' is a heavily contested token. Never optimize for the bare word.
required_title_qualifiers._rule: Title and H1 must each contain at least one of these.

approved_public_customers._source: business-profile.md §6 — names already public in Helium's own marketing. Gate 3 fails any customer name outside this list.

approved_ctas._source: offers.md §8. Gate 2 requires exactly one CTA, drawn from this set.

coined_terms._source: entity-record.md §10 — defend these. Gate 5 requires at least one, defined in one clause.
